svg.title: The Transcribe menu
svg.desc: Transcribe - transcripts and subtitles on your own computer. 1: Transcribe audio or video (text + subtitles). 2: Subtitles from my script (exact words, for example a voiceover). 3: Open the web app in your browser. 4: Check my setup. 5: Download the models now (so nothing downloads later). 0: Exit.

text.font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', monospace

g.font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', monospace
g.text: Transcribe - transcripts and subtitles on your own computer
Subtitles from my script (exact words, for example a voiceover)
Open the web app in your browser
Download the models now (so nothing downloads later)
Type a number and press Enter: 1
